preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s contains only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output is the omeric string formed by concatenating the longest palindromic suffix and the longest palindromic prefix of the input string.
The second line of the output contains a space-separated list of integers representing the frequency of each prefix in the omeric string.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= f <= len(s) for f in output[1].split())
postconditions.description: Each frequency in the second line is a non-negative integer and does not exceed the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(output[1].split().count(str(i)) == s[:i+1].count(s[:i+1][0]) for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: The frequency of each prefix in the second line matches the number of times that prefix appears as a substring in the input string.
